1	/-
2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
5	-/
6	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.FLVClass
7	
8	/-!
9	# DAT-0a — the P5-uniform `H¹`-vanishing bound
10	
11	For the curve bundle `Y` (integral, smooth of relative dimension one, locally of finite type
12	and quasi-compact over a field `K`) carrying a **finite dominant** morphism `π : Y ⟶ ℙ¹`,
13	there is a single integer threshold `b`, depending only on `(Y, π)` and quantified over **all**
14	Weil divisors `D`, past which the degree-one cohomology of `𝒪(D)` vanishes:
15	
16	`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_isFinite_toP1`:
17	`∃ b : ℤ, ∀ D, b ≤ deg D → Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(D))`.
18	
19	This is the **P5-uniform** pre-brick of the Wave-4 datum campaign (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md`
20	§2.1, §4 DAT-0a). It is consumed by DAT-D's uniform Grassmannian twist, where the twist exponent
21	`M` is chosen so that `deg (Θ^M) ≥ b` and the whole degree-`g` family lands in the vanishing
22	locus.
23	
24	## The route (worksheet §4 DAT-0a, collapsed form)
25	
26	The proof is the FLV-class argument (`RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean`) with the twist specialized to the
27	fiber divisor `F = fiberWeilDivisor π` and the base twist fixed at the FLV-fiber threshold `n₁` of
28	`D₀ = 0`:
29	
30	* FLV-fiber at `D₀ = 0` (`subsingleton_hModule_divisorSheaf_one_of_isFinite_toP1`) gives `n₁` with
31	  `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(n·F))` for all `n ≥ n₁`; take `n = n₁`, so the base twist `n₁·F` is fixed;
32	* `0 < deg F` (`zero_lt_deg_fiberWeilDivisor`) makes `b := n₁·deg F + 1 − χ(𝒪_Y)` a legal
33	  threshold: for `deg D ≥ b` the residual class `[D]·[F]^{-n₁}` has degree `≥ 1 − χ`, so
34	  `exists_effective_of_picClass` yields an **effective** witness `E` of that class;
35	* `n₁·F + E` is in the class of `D`; `peel_effective` transports `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(n₁·F))` to
36	  `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(n₁·F + E))`, and witness-independence
37	  (`subsingleton_hModule_one_of_picClass_eq`, W6-lite) upgrades it to `𝒪(D)`.
38	
39	Because `n₁` (hence the base twist) is fixed, the effective witness carries the whole degree slack,
40	and `b` depends only on `(Y, π)` — exactly the shape DAT-D consumes.
41	-/
42	
43	set_option autoImplicit false
44	
45	universe u
46	
47	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
48	
49	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
50	
51	open Scheme
52	
53	section Uniform
54	
55	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
56	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
57	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
58	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
59	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
60	
61	/-- **DAT-0a — the P5-uniform `H¹`-vanishing bound.** For a **finite** dominant `π : Y ⟶ ℙ¹`
62	compatible with the structure morphisms, there is a single threshold `b : ℤ`, depending only on
63	`(Y, π)`, past which the degree-one cohomology of `𝒪(D)` vanishes for **every** Weil divisor `D` of
64	degree `≥ b`:
65	
66	`∃ b, ∀ D, b ≤ deg D → Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(D))`.
67	
68	The bound is `b = n₁·deg F + 1 − χ(𝒪_Y)`, with `F = fiberWeilDivisor π` and `n₁` the FLV-fiber
69	threshold at `D₀ = 0`; see the module docstring for the collapsed route
70	(`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §4 DAT-0a). Consumed by DAT-D's uniform Grassmannian twist. -/
71	theorem exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_isFinite_toP1
72	    [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
73	    [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
74	    (π : Y ⟶ P1 K) [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
75	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap K = Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
76	    ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ D : Y.CurveDivisor, b ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K D →
77	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K D) 1) := by
78	  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ :=
79	    subsingleton_hModule_divisorSheaf_one_of_isFinite_toP1 π hπ (0 : Y.CurveDivisor)
80	  have hd'pos : 0 < CurveDivisor.deg K (fiberWeilDivisor π) :=
81	    zero_lt_deg_fiberWeilDivisor π
82	  refine ⟨(n₁ : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K (fiberWeilDivisor π) + 1
83	      - Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K), fun D hD => ?_⟩
84	  -- the residual class `[D] · [F]^{-n₁}`
85	  set c : Y.CechPic := CurveDivisor.picClass K D
86	    * (CurveDivisor.picClass K (fiberWeilDivisor π) ^ n₁)⁻¹ with hc
87	  have hcdeg : classDeg K c
88	      = CurveDivisor.deg K D - (n₁ : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K (fiberWeilDivisor π) := by
89	    rw [hc, classDeg_mul, classDeg_inv, classDeg_pow, classDeg_picClass, classDeg_picClass]
90	    ring
91	  -- an effective witness of the residual class
92	  obtain ⟨W, hWc⟩ := CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq K c
93	  have hWdeg : 1 ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K W + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
94	    have hWeq : CurveDivisor.deg K W
95	        = CurveDivisor.deg K D - (n₁ : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K (fiberWeilDivisor π) := by
96	      rw [← hcdeg, ← hWc, classDeg_picClass]
97	    linarith
98	  obtain ⟨E, hEnonneg, hEc⟩ := exists_effective_of_picClass W hWdeg
99	  -- the witness divisor `n₁ • F + E` is in the class of `D`
100	  have hclass : CurveDivisor.picClass K (n₁ • fiberWeilDivisor π + E)
101	      = CurveDivisor.picClass K D := by
102	    rw [CurveDivisor.picClass_add, picClass_nsmul, hEc, hWc, hc,
103	      mul_comm (CurveDivisor.picClass K D), ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, one_mul]
104	  -- base vanishing at `n₁ • F`, peel `E`, transport along the class
105	  have hbase : Subsingleton
106	      (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (n₁ • fiberWeilDivisor π)) 1) := by
107	    have h := hn₁ n₁ le_rfl
108	    rwa [zero_add] at h
109	  have hpeel : Subsingleton
110	      (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (n₁ • fiberWeilDivisor π + E)) 1) :=
111	    peel_effective (n₁ • fiberWeilDivisor π) E hEnonneg hbase
112	  exact subsingleton_hModule_one_of_picClass_eq K hclass hpeel
113	
114	end Uniform
115	
116	end AlgebraicGeometry

11	/-!
12	# FLV-2(b) + FLV-3 — the H¹-quotient identification and the fibrewise large-twist vanishing
13	
14	The heart of the Wave-4 fibrewise-large-twist-vanishing campaign
15	(`informal/w4-flv-worksheet.md` §§2.1, 2.3, bricks FLV-2(b) and FLV-3), for the curve
16	bundle `Y` (integral, smooth of relative dimension one and quasi-compact over a field `K`)
17	with a dominant affine morphism `π : Y ⟶ ℙ¹` and its fiber divisor
18	`F = fiberWeilDivisor π` (`AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.FLVFiberToolkit`).
19	
20	## The identification (FLV-2(b))
21	
22	On the affine two-cover `V₀ = π⁻¹ D₊(X₀)`, `V₁ = π⁻¹ D₊(X₁)`, the general-coefficients
23	two-cover carrier `Scheme.twoCoverH1LinearEquiv` — its two affine vanishing instances
24	discharged by the quasi-coherence packaging of `AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.FLVQcoh` —
25	computes `H¹` of the twisted sheaf `𝒪(D + n·F)` as a cokernel of section modules. This
26	file identifies that cokernel with a quotient of the **fixed** ambient overlap lattice
27	`N = 𝒪(D)(V₀ ⊓ V₁)` (constant in `n`, by the landed overlap-constancy
28	`divisorSections_add_nsmul_fiberWeilDivisor_overlap`) by the fiber lattice `Aₙ` of
29	`AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.FLVLattice`, comapped through `N.subtype` — the one
30	submodule-of-submodule bridge of the campaign, paid once behind the named submodule
31	`AlgebraicGeometry.fiberLatticeOverlap` (worksheet discipline (2)):
32	
33	`AlgebraicGeometry.fiberLatticeH1Equiv :
34	  HModule (𝒪(D + n·F)) 1 ≃ₗ[K] N ⧸ fiberLatticeOverlap π D n`.
35	
36	## The endgame (FLV-3)
37	
38	`Submodule.eventually_eq_top_of_monotone_of_iSup_eq_top` is the pure linear-algebra
39	stabilization: an increasing `ℕ`-chain of submodules with join `⊤` whose base has
40	Noetherian quotient is eventually `⊤` (images in the quotient by the base stabilize by
41	`monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian`, and the stabilized value must be everything).
42	Instantiated with `Aₙ` inside `N`:
43	
44	* the chain is increasing (`fiberLattice_mono`) and exhausts `N` (`iSup_fiberLattice`,
45	  THE EXHAUSTION of FLV-1 — pole clearing at the finite fiber over `[1 : 0]`);
46	* `N ⧸ A₀` is finite-dimensional: it is `H¹(𝒪(D + 0·F))` through the identification, and
47	  every divisor sheaf has finite `H¹` by the landed dévissage
48	  (`moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_one`, `AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.ChiFiniteness`)
49	  — the only place the base finiteness (properness) inputs enter;
50	
51	so `Aₙ = ⊤` for all large `n`, and through the identification the twisted `H¹` is a
52	subsingleton — **the fibrewise large-twist vanishing**
53	(`AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_hModule_divisorSheaf_one_of_isDominant_toP1`): per-class
54	`n₀`, no duality, no `R¹f_*`. The worksheet-shaped form for a finite dominant `π`
55	compatible with the structure morphisms
56	(`subsingleton_hModule_divisorSheaf_one_of_isFinite_toP1`) discharges the base
57	`H¹(𝒪_Y)`-finiteness input from finiteness of `π`
58	(`moduleFinite_hModule_one_of_isFinite_toP1`).
59	-/

69	/-- **Noetherian stabilization of an exhausting chain.** An increasing `ℕ`-chain of
70	submodules whose join is everything and whose base term has Noetherian quotient is
71	eventually everything: the images of the chain in the quotient by the base term stabilize,
72	and the stabilized image must be the whole quotient. This is the pure linear-algebra
73	endgame of the fibrewise large-twist vanishing (`informal/w4-flv-worksheet.md` §2.1). -/
74	theorem Submodule.eventually_eq_top_of_monotone_of_iSup_eq_top {R : Type u} {M : Type v}
75	    [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {A : ℕ → Submodule R M} (hmono : Monotone A)
76	    (hsup : ⨆ n, A n = ⊤) [IsNoetherian R (M ⧸ A 0)] :
77	    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, A n = ⊤ := by
78	  set f : ℕ →o Submodule R (M ⧸ A 0) :=
79	    ⟨fun n => (A n).map (A 0).mkQ, fun a b hab => Submodule.map_mono (hmono hab)⟩ with hf
80	  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ :=
81	    monotone_stabilizes_iff_noetherian.mpr ‹IsNoetherian R (M ⧸ A 0)› f
82	  have hftop : f n₀ = ⊤ := by
83	    have h1 : ⨆ n, f n = ⊤ := by
84	      have h2 : ⨆ n, f n = Submodule.map (A 0).mkQ (⨆ n, A n) :=
85	        (Submodule.map_iSup _ _).symm
86	      rw [h2, hsup, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_mkQ]
87	    have h3 : ∀ m, f m ≤ f n₀ := fun m => by
88	      rcases le_total m n₀ with h | h
89	      · exact f.mono h
90	      · exact (hn₀ m h).ge
91	    have h4 : (⊤ : Submodule R (M ⧸ A 0)) ≤ f n₀ := by
92	      rw [← h1]; exact iSup_le h3
93	    exact le_antisymm le_top h4
94	  refine ⟨n₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
95	  have hfn : (A n).map (A 0).mkQ = ⊤ := by
96	    have h5 : f n = ⊤ := by rw [← hn₀ n hn]; exact hftop
97	    exact h5
98	  have hcomap := congrArg (Submodule.comap (A 0).mkQ) hfn
99	  rwa [Submodule.comap_map_mkQ, Submodule.comap_top,
100	    sup_eq_right.mpr (hmono (Nat.zero_le n))] at hcomap
101	
102	end Stabilization

119	/-- **The fiber lattice inside the fixed ambient overlap module** (the FLV-2(b) bridge
120	submodule): the Čech `H¹` denominator `Aₙ = 𝒪(D + n·F)(V₀) ⊔ 𝒪(D + n·F)(V₁)` of
121	`AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.FLVLattice`, viewed as a submodule of the fixed ambient
122	`N = 𝒪(D)(V₀ ⊓ V₁)` through `N.subtype` (`fiberLattice_le_overlap` certifies the
123	containment). All submodule-of-submodule bookkeeping of the campaign is sealed behind
124	this definition. -/
125	noncomputable def fiberLatticeOverlap (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) :
126	    Submodule K (divisorSections K D (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)) :=
127	  (fiberLattice π D n).comap
128	    (divisorSections K D (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)).subtype

130	lemma mem_fiberLatticeOverlap {D : Y.CurveDivisor} {n : ℕ}
131	    {s : divisorSections K D (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)} :
132	    s ∈ fiberLatticeOverlap π D n ↔ (s : Y.functionField) ∈ fiberLattice π D n :=
133	  Iff.rfl

136	(`fiberLattice_mono` comapped). -/
137	lemma fiberLatticeOverlap_mono (D : Y.CurveDivisor) :
138	    Monotone (fiberLatticeOverlap π D) := fun _ _ h =>
139	  Submodule.comap_mono ((monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fiberLattice_mono π D)) h)

141	/-- **Exhaustion inside the ambient** (`iSup_fiberLattice` comapped): the increasing chain
142	`Aₙ` fills the whole of `N = 𝒪(D)(V₀ ⊓ V₁)`. -/
143	theorem iSup_fiberLatticeOverlap (D : Y.CurveDivisor) :
144	    ⨆ n, fiberLatticeOverlap π D n = ⊤ := by
145	  rw [eq_top_iff]
146	  rintro s -
147	  have hs : (s : Y.functionField) ∈ ⨆ n, fiberLattice π D n := by
148	    rw [iSup_fiberLattice π D]
149	    exact s.2
150	  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed _
151	    (monotone_nat_of_le_succ (fiberLattice_mono π D)).directed_le).mp hs
152	  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem m hm

165	/-- The underlying rational function of the two-cover restriction-difference of a pair of
166	sections of `𝒪(D')` on the π-charts: restriction preserves values, so the difference map
167	computes the literal difference in `K(Y)`. -/
168	private lemma divisorVal_moduleDiff (D' : Y.CurveDivisor)
169	    (t : ((Y.divisorSheaf K D').obj.obj (op (fiberChart₀ π)))
170	      × ((Y.divisorSheaf K D').obj.obj (op (fiberChart₁ π)))) :
171	    divisorVal K ((Y.twoCoverSquare (fiberChart₀ π) (fiberChart₁ π)
172	        (preimage_chartOpen_sup π)).moduleDiff (Y.divisorSheaf K D') t)
173	      = divisorVal K t.1 - divisorVal K t.2 := by
174	  have hov : ((fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π : Y.Opens) : Set Y).Nonempty :=
175	    ⟨genericPoint Y, genericPoint_mem_preimage_inf π⟩
176	  have h1 : divisorVal K
177	      (((Y.divisorSheaf K D').obj.map
178	        (Y.twoCoverSquare (fiberChart₀ π) (fiberChart₁ π)
179	          (preimage_chartOpen_sup π)).f₁₂.op).hom t.1) = divisorVal K t.1 :=
180	    divisorPresheaf_map_val K _ hov t.1
181	  have h2 : divisorVal K
182	      (((Y.divisorSheaf K D').obj.map
183	        (Y.twoCoverSquare (fiberChart₀ π) (fiberChart₁ π)
184	          (preimage_chartOpen_sup π)).f₁₃.op).hom t.2) = divisorVal K t.2 :=
185	    divisorPresheaf_map_val K _ hov t.2
186	  rw [GrothendieckTopology.MayerVietorisSquare.moduleDiff_apply, divisorVal_sub, h1, h2]

189	/-- **The range of the two-cover difference map is the fiber lattice** (the general-`F`
190	restatement of the landed structure-sheaf `range_diff_eq` of
191	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.Finiteness`, assigned to FLV-2 by the worksheet §2.3): a
192	section of `𝒪(D + n·F)` on the overlap is a difference of restrictions from `V₀` and `V₁`
193	exactly when its underlying rational function lies in
194	`Aₙ = 𝒪(D + n·F)(V₀) ⊔ 𝒪(D + n·F)(V₁)`. -/
195	private lemma range_moduleDiff_eq_comap (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) :
196	    LinearMap.range ((Y.twoCoverSquare (fiberChart₀ π) (fiberChart₁ π)
197	        (preimage_chartOpen_sup π)).moduleDiff
198	        (Y.divisorSheaf K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)))
199	      = (fiberLattice π D n).comap
200	          (divisorSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)
201	            (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)).subtype := by
202	  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
203	  · rintro y ⟨t, rfl⟩
204	    have hmem : divisorVal K ((Y.twoCoverSquare (fiberChart₀ π) (fiberChart₁ π)
205	          (preimage_chartOpen_sup π)).moduleDiff
206	          (Y.divisorSheaf K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)) t) ∈ fiberLattice π D n := by
207	      rw [divisorVal_moduleDiff π (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) t]
208	      exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left (divisorVal_mem K t.1))
209	        (Submodule.mem_sup_right (divisorVal_mem K t.2))
210	    exact hmem
211	  · intro y hy
212	    have hy' : divisorVal K y ∈ fiberLattice π D n := hy
213	    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hy'
214	    refine ⟨((⟨a, ha⟩ : divisorSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) (fiberChart₀ π)),
215	      (⟨-b, Submodule.neg_mem _ hb⟩ :
216	        divisorSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) (fiberChart₁ π))), ?_⟩
217	    refine divisorSection_ext K ?_
218	    rw [divisorVal_moduleDiff π (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)]
219	    have hfin : a - (-b) = divisorVal K y := by
220	      rw [sub_neg_eq_add]
221	      exact hab
222	    exact hfin

224	/-- Mapping the comap of a submodule along `LinearEquiv.ofEq` of equal submodules is the
225	comap along the other subtype. -/
226	private lemma map_ofEq_comap_subtype {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M]
227	    [Module R M] {p q : Submodule R M} (h : p = q) (A : Submodule R M) :
228	    Submodule.map (LinearEquiv.ofEq p q h : p →ₗ[R] q) (A.comap p.subtype)
229	      = A.comap q.subtype := by
230	  subst h
231	  rw [LinearEquiv.ofEq_rfl]
232	  simp

234	/-- **The H¹-quotient identification** (FLV-2(b), the carrier): the degree-one cohomology
235	of the twisted divisor sheaf `𝒪(D + n·F)` is the quotient of the **fixed** ambient overlap
236	lattice `N = 𝒪(D)(V₀ ⊓ V₁)` by the fiber lattice `Aₙ` viewed inside `N`. Composite of the
237	two-cover carrier `Scheme.twoCoverH1LinearEquiv` (its affine vanishing instances
238	discharged by the `QcohOn` packaging of `AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.FLVQcoh`), the
239	range identification `range (moduleDiff) = Aₙ`, and the overlap-constancy
240	`𝒪(D + n·F)(V₀ ⊓ V₁) = N` of `AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.FLVLattice`. -/
241	noncomputable def fiberLatticeH1Equiv (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) :
242	    Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)) 1 ≃ₗ[K]
243	      (divisorSections K D (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)
244	        ⧸ fiberLatticeOverlap π D n) :=
245	  haveI : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule'
246	      (Y.divisorSheaf K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)) (fiberChart₀ π) 1) :=
247	    (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 0).subsingleton_hModule'_divisorSheaf_one K _
248	  haveI : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule'
249	      (Y.divisorSheaf K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)) (fiberChart₁ π) 1) :=
250	    (isAffineOpen_preimage_chartOpen π 1).subsingleton_hModule'_divisorSheaf_one K _
251	  (Scheme.twoCoverH1LinearEquiv K Y (fiberChart₀ π) (fiberChart₁ π)
252	      (Y.divisorSheaf K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)) (preimage_chartOpen_sup π)).trans
253	    ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (range_moduleDiff_eq_comap π D n)).trans
254	      (Submodule.Quotient.equiv _ _
255	        (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (divisorSections_add_nsmul_fiberWeilDivisor_overlap π D n))
256	        (map_ofEq_comap_subtype
257	          (divisorSections_add_nsmul_fiberWeilDivisor_overlap π D n)
258	          (fiberLattice π D n))))
259	
260	/-- **Fibrewise large-twist vanishing** (FLV-fiber, the Wave-4 headline; conditional form
261	for a dominant affine `π : Y ⟶ ℙ¹`): for every Weil divisor `D` on the curve bundle `Y`,
262	the degree-one cohomology of the twisted divisor sheaf `𝒪(D + n·F)`, `F` the fiber divisor
263	of `π`, vanishes for all sufficiently large `n`. The bound `n₀` is per-class and
264	non-effective — Noetherian stabilization of the exhausting fiber-lattice chain inside the
265	finite-codimension ambient `N`, per `informal/w4-flv-worksheet.md` §2.1; no duality, no
266	`R¹f_*`. The two `Module.Finite` hypotheses are the structure-sheaf properness inputs of
267	the landed dévissage (`moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_one`). -/
268	theorem subsingleton_hModule_divisorSheaf_one_of_isDominant_toP1
269	    [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
270	    [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
271	    (D : Y.CurveDivisor) :
272	    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀,
273	      Subsingleton
274	        (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)) 1) := by
275	  haveI hfin : Module.Finite K
276	      (divisorSections K D (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)
277	        ⧸ fiberLatticeOverlap π D 0) :=
278	    Module.Finite.equiv (fiberLatticeH1Equiv π D 0)
279	  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := Submodule.eventually_eq_top_of_monotone_of_iSup_eq_top
280	    (fiberLatticeOverlap_mono π D) (iSup_fiberLatticeOverlap π D)
281	  refine ⟨n₀, fun n hn => ?_⟩
282	  haveI : Subsingleton (divisorSections K D (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)
283	      ⧸ fiberLatticeOverlap π D n) :=
284	    Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr (hn₀ n hn)
285	  exact (fiberLatticeH1Equiv π D n).toEquiv.subsingleton
286	
287	end Carrier
